data.one_liner: ValueNotifier outside Flutter for managing state in an immutable manner.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StateNotifier class to control application state outside Flutter with immutable objects. It supports change notifications based on object identity and integrates with Provider or Riverpod.
use_when: You want a simple way to manage immutable state with Provider or Riverpod.
You need to centralize business logic inside notifier classes.
avoid_when: You want a complex out-of-the-box architecture with events and states like BLoC.
You prefer mutable state notification classes like ChangeNotifier.
strengths: Enforces immutable state updates via centralized methods.
Supports custom notification filtering via updateShouldNotify.
Provides LocatorMixin for easy integration with dependency injection.
weaknesses: Relies on object identity (identical) by default, requiring custom updateShouldNotify overrides for deep equality comparisons.
Updating state outside the notifier is considered an anti-pattern.
